jobs.title: VP / Head of Product
jobs.description:
GENERAL MEDICINE HAS RAISED $120M IN SERIES B FUNDING TO BUILD THE HEALTHCARE STORE.

The round was led by Vineeta Agarwala, MD, PhD, of Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), and is the largest investment to date from a16z's bio + health team. Read the announcement. https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/general-medicine-raises-120-million-to-build-the-healthcare-store-302899356.html

Healthcare needs a store. People should be able to see prices, understand their options, and get advice from clinicians as easily as they shop for anything else. That's what we're building, and this Series B will help us expand the store and reach more customers across the United States.

To learn more, read CEO TJ Parker's post on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7513259806867185664/ and the a16z team's post on Substack https://www.a16z.news/p/investing-in-general-medicine.

If this sounds interesting, we're hiring. Help us build the store.




ABOUT GENERAL MEDICINE

General Medicine is building a healthcare store that makes it delightfully simple to access the best care in the world. We make it easy for customers to shop for any product or service in healthcare, compare upfront cash and insurance prices, understand if the service is right for them and purchase it.

Behind that simplicity is complex infrastructure: payer integrations, pricing logic, eligibility systems, reconciliation workflows, and financial rails. We're building the system that makes transact-able healthcare possible.




THE ROLE

We're hiring a VP / Head of Product to build our product function from the ground up. This is the founding product leadership seat: you'll set how we roadmap, how we prioritize, how ideas get pitched and greenlit, and how product and engineering work together, before writing most of that playbook yourself.

This role reports directly to the CEO and sits on the senior leadership team.

You'll own the roadmap across consumer experience, clinical/provider tooling, and pricing and payer infrastructure, allocating engineering capacity across these areas. You will drive priorities and build alignment across the CEO, Medical Director, and senior leadership team.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Build the function

 - Establish the product org: hiring, processes, review cadences, and operating rhythms

 - Establish how we write specs, define success metrics, run experiments, and decide what to build next

 - Define complex initiatives—such as new consumer experiences, payer integrations, or clinical workflows. Turn those into execution plans with clear owners.

Own the roadmap

 - Set and evolve a product roadmap across multiple focus areas at once, balancing consumer experience, clinical delivery, and the pricing and payer infrastructure underneath both

 - Allocate engineering capacity and justify trade-offs across competing priorities

 - Balance near-term delivery with core architecture and infrastructure needs

Sell the vision

 - Develop business cases for proposed features, including resource needs, expected outcomes, and timing

 - Champion initiatives with the CEO, Medical Director, CFO, and VP Engineering

 - Communicate product strategy internally to cross-functional teams and externally to partners, payers, and investors

Ship



 - Write specs, review designs, and resolve day-to-day blockers for engineering

 - Partner with engineering leadership on sprint planning, sequencing, and capacity estimation using customer and care-team insights


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You have founder or early product leadership experience taking products from 0 to 1. You have acquired initial users, pitched stakeholders, and established core operational workflows in ambiguous environments.

Specifically:

 - You've built and shipped a product from 0 to 1, whether as a founder, an early product hire, or in a similarly ownership-heavy role

 - Demonstrated ability to build data-backed business cases and secure buy-in from leadership

 - You've managed a roadmap across more than one workstream at a time and made real tradeoffs about where limited engineering capacity goes

 - You've built product process and team structure from scratch rather than inheriting it

 - You come from a startup background and are comfortable with ambiguity, thin resourcing, and moving fast

 - Clear written and verbal communication skills to align engineering, clinical, and business stakeholders

Nice to have:

 - Healthcare, healthtech, or another regulated-industry background

 - Experience in a marketplace or two-sided business model

 - A quantitative or technical background that lets you go deep with engineering when needed

This is a hybrid role in SF




HOW WE WORK

 - Customer obsessed: We stay close to real needs through thoughtful research and continuous feedback from our care teams - the same instinct that shapes how you'll sequence and ship the roadmap above.

 - Design led & data informed: We seek simplicity, ship craftsmanship, and validate with data.

 - Operationally grounded: We build tools that make our care teams faster and more accurate, not just prettier.

To learn more, read CEO TJ Parker's post on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7513259806867185664/ and the a16z team's post on Substack https://www.a16z.news/p/investing-in-general-medicine.

About General Medicine

General Medicine is building a healthcare store that makes it radically simpler — and more transparent — for people to access care. We provide upfront cash and insurance prices for visits, prescriptions, labs, imaging, and more.

Behind that simplicity is complex infrastructure: payer integrations, pricing logic, eligibility systems, reconciliation workflows, and financial rails.

We’re building the systems that make transparent healthcare possible.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Product Manager, Growth at General Medicine, you’ll help scale a healthcare store that makes it delightfully simple for people to take care of their health. We provide upfront cash and insurance prices for virtual and in-person visits, prescriptions, labs, imaging, and more. You will build the systems that connect our platform to payers, employer partners, and healthcare networks. This isn’t a maintenance role — it’s foundational. You’ll define how complex external relationships translate into scalable, reliable infrastructure inside our product.

We’re looking for a scrappy, analytical PM who’s comfortable in ambiguity and strong in execution. You’ll dive into messy inputs, structure hard problems, and work side-by-side with engineering to ship integrations, APIs, and workflows that power real-world operations. You’ll set clear roadmaps, define success metrics, and ensure what we build scales cleanly as volume and complexity grow.

This role sits at the intersection of product, data, and backend systems. You’ll turn cross-functional complexity into durable architecture — building the enterprise layer that enables everything else to move faster.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own enterprise-facing product initiatives end-to-end, from problem definition through launch and iteration

 - Define and maintain a clear enterprise product roadmap aligned to company goals and partner needs

 - Design and prioritize complex integrations with payers and other external partners, balancing technical constraints with business impact

 - Translate regulatory, contractual, and operational requirements into clear, testable product specifications

 - Partner closely with engineering to scope APIs, data models, workflows, and system architecture decisions

 - Define success metrics and monitor system performance, reliability, and partner experience post-launch

 - Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and scale partner integrations over time

 - Drive structured decision-making across cross-functional stakeholders

 - Contribute to the long-term strategy and evolution of our B2B platform




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 4–8 years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS or integration-heavy environments

 - Experience owning technically complex product surfaces or infrastructure

 - Strong analytical skills and comfort working with multi-source data and operational systems

 - Ability to define metrics, evaluate tradeoffs, and prioritize under constraint

 - Technical fluency — comfortable discussing APIs, data flows, and system design with engineers

 - Track record of operating effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

 - Clear, structured communicator who can align engineering, leadership, and external partners
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience working with healthcare, fintech, or other regulated systems

 - Experience scaling enterprise integrations across multiple partners

 - Quantitative or technical academic background



This is a hybrid role in SF.

Compensation is between 175-225k base + equity options.




WHY JOIN

We’re an experienced team that’s built in this space before and have a distinctive vision for what healthcare can look like when designed around transparency and simplicity. We believe that modern growth is a product function — not just marketing — and we’re building for the long term.

You’ll be the first Growth PM, reporting directly to the CEO and shaping how we define and drive growth across the company. Your work will have immediate, measurable impact and deep visibility with leadership.

This role is based in San Francisco (near Market and Spear St). We expect our team to work from the office at least three days per week.

You’ll work with a small, high-leverage team of engineers and designers to make complex healthcare simple, trustworthy, and delightful. This is a hands-on role: writing specs, defining metrics, reviewing experiments, and partnering closely with engineering, while also shaping the product’s long-term evolution.

We’re looking for someone with experience shipping impactful consumer products, turning ambiguous problems into clear solutions, and using data to drive iteration. You don’t need deep healthcare experience—what matters is strong product judgment, analytical rigor, and a track record of creating experiences users love.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own and evolve a clear consumer product roadmap aligned to company goals

 - Define, prioritize, and ship 0→1 features that improve user experience and business outcomes

 - Identify the highest-leverage opportunities across onboarding, conversion, booking, and retention

 - Partner closely with engineering and key stakeholders to scope, sequence, and execute initiatives efficiently

 - Design and run experiments to validate hypotheses and improve key metrics

 - Analyze product performance and user behavior data to inform prioritization and iteration

 - Translate ambiguous problems into structured plans with measurable success criteria

 - Balance speed and rigor — shipping quickly while building durable foundations

 - Contribute to broader consumer product strategy and long-term experience vision
   


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5-10+ years of product management experience, ideally on consumer-facing web products

 - Experience owning a roadmap and driving measurable outcomes

 - Strong analytical foundation — comfortable defining KPIs, running experiments, and interpreting data

 - Track record of improving core metrics (conversion, engagement, retention, etc.)

 - Experience operating with ambiguity and setting direction without heavy structure

 - Ability to move between strategy and execution — from high-level prioritization to detailed product specs

 - Clear communicator who can align engineering, design, and leadership around tradeoffs and outcomes


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience scaling a product from early traction to meaningful growth

 - Consumer Healthcare experience preferred but not required

 - Quantitative or technical academic background
   
   

This is a hybrid role in SF.

Compensation ranges from 175-225k base + equity options
